Title: Public preview: Java support for App Service on Linux

Body.Content:
We announced the general availability of Azure App Service on Linux and Web App for Containers in September 2017. Today, we’re adding more language runtime support for built-in images. You can now create a Linux web app by using Tomcat 8.5 or 9.0, with JRE 8 as a runtime stack.

For details on the Java preview release, check out our blog post.
